COSMO CORGI - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-cosmocorgi.txt.

A corgi astronaut flies its little rocket through space: a pastel nebula, an
asteroid belt, a robot space station and the icy comets, each guarded by a big
robot critter. The rocket barks star shots all by itself: you just fly it
and dodge. Wind-up robots, drones and little UFOs pop into sparkles and bolts;
pop a whole gold group (or a gift carrier) for a capsule: the spread shot, the
star beam, homing bones, speed, a shield, and puppy pods that fly along and
fire too. One hit ends the run (the shield takes one). The robots come in
ever greater numbers, from every side; after the four bosses the trip starts
again, faster and busier. Medals at 2000, 7000, 20000 and 40000, and your
best score is kept.

Run CosmoCorgi.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  fly (8 directions)        D-pad                      arrow keys
  fire                      (by itself, always)
  start                     A (or B, X, Y, Start,      X or Enter
                            the D-pad)
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a run) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             drag anywhere: the rocket moves as your finger
                            moves (it never hides under it); a tap starts

Up to four corgis (red, blue, green and purple rockets) fly together, each
with their own pad and score; each is out on its own hit, the trip ends when
all are out, and the results rank everyone by score, with medals.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: CosmoCorgi.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in cosmocorgi.srm next to the exe.
